tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Creates a new folder directory at the specified path, including any necessary parent directories. If the folder already exists, returns success=true without mutating content. Fails if a regular file already exists at the target path.

directory_path.description: The absolute path of the folder to create, e.g., '/sdcard/Download/NewFolder'.

success.description: True if the folder was successfully created or already exists.

path.description: The absolute path of the created folder.

error.description: Error message if the operation failed.

tools.name: delete_path
tools.description: Deletes the file or directory at the specified path. If recursive is true, traverses and deletes all child files and folders first. If recursive is false, fails if the target is a non-empty directory. Notifies MediaStore of the deletion.

path.description: The absolute path of the file or folder to delete.

recursive.description: Must be true to delete a non-empty folder. If false, folder deletion will fail if it contains items.

success.description: True if the path was successfully deleted.

error.description: Error message if the operation failed.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List of direct child files and folders containing name, path, is_directory, size, and modified_time. Returns empty list or structured error if directory does not exist or is inaccessible.

directory_path.description: The absolute path of the directory to list, e.g., '/sdcard/Download' or '/sdcard/Documents'.

tools.name: write_file_text
tools.description: Writes string bytes using UTF-8 encoding to the target file path. Creates the file if it does not exist. Overwrites if specified. Triggers MediaStore scan.

file_path.description: The absolute path of the file to write, e.g., '/sdcard/Download/notes.txt'.

content.description: The text content to write into the file.

overwrite.description: If true, overwrites the file if it already exists. If false, fails if the file exists.

success.description: True if the file was successfully written.

path.description: The absolute path of the written file.

size.description: The size of the written file in bytes.

error.description: Error message if the operation failed.
